title: Practice 2: пере-: across, and over to another place

exercises.q: Река здесь мелкая — мы можем ___ (перейти / переходить) вброд.
exercises.why: **перейти́** — **переходи́ть** — to cross, to get over, to get across; to pass on (to), to proceed (to), to turn (to). **перее́хать** — **переезжа́ть** — to move (to change residence); to cross, to run over, to drive over. **перелете́ть** — **перелета́ть** — to fly (from one place to another or above something); to fly too far, to overshoot (the mark). **перебежа́ть** — **перебега́ть** — to run (across), to cross (at a run [running]); to move, to shift. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
